WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_lines, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND f.channel_id=1
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
  GROUP BY 1),
p AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id,p.store_id) store_id, s.gross_sales, s.staff, s.n_rows-s.n_lines dup, s.days, r.ret, r.n-r.nd retdup, p.b rpt_before, p.rn rpt_ret, p.ns rpt_net, p.days rptdays,
 s.gross_sales - coalesce(r.ret,0) calc_net
FROM s FULL JOIN r ON r.store_id=s.store_id FULL JOIN p ON p.store_id=coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id)
ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS ps, period_end_date AS pe
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key, per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND f.channel_id = 1 AND d.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = r.store_key, per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe AND d.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
net AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.amt - coalesce(r.amt, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id))
SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY n.net_sales DESC) AS net_sales_rank,
       n.store_id, c.store_name, round(n.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales
FROM net n JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) c USING (store_id), per
ORDER BY net_sales_rank
